conversionFunnelNotice: Stages completed in order by the same member on the same post over 30 days, excluding the author and signed-out readers. Applying and creating a copy are atomic, so the last two stages normally match. No message bodies are collected.
title: Community
allowFork: Allow members to copy this itinerary for free
name: Name
includeUncertain: Also show uncertain or non-matching places
changeVerificationPeriod: Change verification period in community settings
communityIntroduction: Share real journeys and turn saved inspiration into your next trip.
closed: The community is currently closed. Travel tools remain available.
statusUnavailable: We cannot confirm community availability. Please try again later.
unavailable: This action could not be completed. Please try again.
verifyRequired: Verify your email before posting, commenting or messaging.
profilePrivacy: These details are public. Your email and login details are never used as your public identity automatically.
handleHelp: 3–30 lowercase letters, digits or underscores; start with a letter. Cannot be changed later.
topicsHelp: Up to 8 comma-separated topics, 40 characters each.
imageRules: Up to {count} JPEG, PNG or WebP images, 10 MB each. Location metadata is removed.
placeIdsHelp: Copy IDs from pet-friendly place pages and separate with commas. Only reviewed places can be linked.
itineraryPrivacy: Only relative days, stops and durations are shared—not private notes, lodging, flights, bookings, traveler details or prices.
previewRequired: Preview and confirm the public snapshot before publishing an itinerary.
confirmPublicSnapshot: I approve this public snapshot and understand that later private trip edits will not update it automatically.
moderationNotice: Your first 3 distinct posts require review. Flagged content is also reviewed. The last approved version stays public while edits are pending.
deleteConfirm: Delete this content? This cannot be undone.
withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this post? New views and copies stop; existing private copies remain.
deleteCollectionConfirm: Delete this collection? Original posts and places are not deleted.
blockWarning: Blocking hides each other while signed in and stops interaction. Signed-out visitors may still see public content. Block this member?
mutualOnly: Messaging requires mutual follows and verified accounts. Unfollowing, blocking or restriction stops new messages.
forkNotice: Create a free private copy with author attribution. Old prices and routes are excluded; recalculation shows its usage cost first.
forkNotAllowed: Copying this itinerary is currently unavailable.
privateTripMessageNotice: Only public content can be shared. Preview and publish a public version of a private trip first.
reportMessageScope: Only the {count} selected messages are submitted as report evidence.
reportPrivacyNotice: Message reports show only evidence selected by the reporter, not unrestricted inbox access.
deleteAccountWarning: Deletion immediately signs you out and hides public content. Personal data and media are cleaned in the background; accounting records and delivered conversations retain a de-identified identity. This cannot be undone.
mailSent: Your email is queued. Check your inbox; the link expires and works only once.
resetNotice: Enter your sign-in email to request a time-limited, single-use reset link.
resetSent: If this account can reset its password, an email will arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
confirmEmailNotice: Confirm your email to use community features that require verification.
petIntroduction: Find reviewed pet policies for restaurants, cafés, shops, lodging and attractions. Coverage reflects actual verified data.
petUncertaintyNotice: Missing information means unknown, not unrestricted. Rules can change; confirm with the place before visiting.
candidateNotice: Suggested places appear publicly only after review. Provide accurate identifying information.
experienceNotice: Traveler experiences are separate from official rules. Reports require review and do not overwrite verified policies.
manualConflictNotice: This place is not confirmed compatible. You may add it manually, but check with the place. AI will not select incompatible places.
petAiNotice: AI uses only currently verified, compatible candidates and reports shortages. Existing manual stops are not removed automatically.
launchNotice: Community is off by default. Enable publicly only after acceptance testing, policies, contact details, storage, email, translation budget and moderation staffing are ready. Configured does not mean connectivity has been verified.
metricsNotice: Distinct members in the last 30 days, excluding authors' own saves and copies. Message bodies are not analyzed.
reviewPetNotice: Record only source-supported conditions. Unknown is not unrestricted. Every save records the reason, check time and change history.
speciesHelp: Use dog or cat; explicitly name any other species.
searchScope: Search original post text, authors and catalogued places; cross-language semantic search is not guaranteed.
noConversations: No conversations yet. Follow each other to start.
noPetPlaces: No verified places match. Adjust filters or include uncertain information.
contentUnavailable: This content is no longer available.
